title: Sinusoidal Positional Encoding
signature: def positional_encoding(max_len: int, d_model: int, base: float = 10000.0) -> np.ndarray
hints: Column pair (2i, 2i+1) shares one frequency: 1 / base^(2i / d_model).
Build angles = pos[:, None] * freq[None, :] with shape (max_len, d_model / 2).
Sines go in the even columns and cosines in the odd ones: pe[:, 0::2] and pe[:, 1::2]. They are interleaved, not concatenated.
